rules.title: Core Grafana concepts
rules.description: Explore data sources, queries, dashboards, and alerting. No setup required.

rules.title: Explore time series
rules.description: Build a time series panel with built-in sample data. Requires permission to create dashboards.

rules.title: Transform query results
rules.description: Shape sample data with transformations. Requires dashboard editing access and the TestData data source.

rules.title: Create dashboard playlists
rules.description: Cycle through your dashboards in a playlist. Requires Editor access and at least two dashboards.

rules.title: Configure Grafana IRM
rules.description: Set up on-call schedules, escalation chains, and alert routing. Requires Grafana Cloud with IRM access.

rules.title: Get started with Frontend Observability
rules.description: Connect your web application with the Faro Web SDK. Requires Grafana Cloud with Frontend Observability access.
